sloka: प्रीत्या च रममाणो ऽथ राघवः परवीरहा ।बहुमानेन महता हनुमन्तमवैक्षत ।। ५.६४.३९ ।।
transliteration: prītyā ca ramamāṇo 'tha rāghavaḥ paravīrahā ।bahumānena mahatā hanumantamavaikṣata ।। 5.64.39 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva and Lakshmana glanced at Hanuman respectfully with affection thinking surely Hanuman alone has succeeded.
